summary: Delixy Holdings Limited, a Singapore-based oil-products trader listed on Nasdaq under DLXY, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a 1-for-5 reverse share split of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, approved by the board on August 12, 2026, following shareholder authorization at the February 23, 2026 general meeting that delegated the final ratio. Post-split trading begins September 28, 2026 under new CUSIP G2703G 111, with roughly 1,434,800 Class A and 1,835,200 Class B shares outstanding. Stated purpose is maintaining the Nasdaq minimum bid price; no fractional shares are issued.
